name: The Ironclad
bio: The last soldier of the Ironclads. Bound to a demon, he crushes foes with sword and flame against his will.
motif: A vow written in blood. A blade made for the climb.

name: The Silent
bio: A huntress from outside the Spire. She moves through the shadows, ready to stab and poison anything in her way.
motif: The quietest step often comes just before the strike.

name: The Defect
bio: An automaton eternally modifying itself to survive. It deploys Orb technology when it must fight.
motif: Old purpose, new power. The machine keeps changing.

name: The Necrobinder
bio: A Spireborn lich who seeks revenge. In combat, she calls upon her trusty left hand, Osty.
motif: Some bonds outlast the body that made them.

name: The Regent
epithet: HEIR TO THE THRONE OF STARS
bio: Heir to the Throne of Stars. He wields cosmic powers, while his minions do the work.
motif: A crown among the constellations. A blade still to be forged.

name: Neow
bio: An exiled Ancient who waits at the start of the climb. Neow brings the fallen back and offers a blessing before the ascent.
